name: LFO Basics
author: Freek van Gool
description: Common LFO settings by use: vibrato and tremolo, auto-pan, filter sweeps, wobble, rhythmic gates from clock divisions, drawn step patterns, generative randomness, slow ambient movement, trigger envelopes and tempo divisions for different music styles. Assign the LFO to parameters on the device card; the presets hold only the LFO itself.
